title: run_request body (sealed)
description: Ask another Obi to run one of this Obi's owner's jobs on its Mac, in a VM of its own, with this owner's own agent account (protocol.md 5.10). The code and the job's words travel on the job channel, never in the request: the audit chain keeps only what the job is. The model's calls go back to this Obi through it. Sealed: derived from actions/run_request.schema.json by spec/conformance/generate.mjs, every x-obi-text field a sealed_text (spec/protocol.md section 9.1). Don't edit it by hand.

account.description: Run it on a share the receiver's owner gave this owner (protocol.md 5.14) instead of this owner's own account: the receiver adds its own key, and the model's calls stay on its Mac.
